You may only use one Party Skill per encounter.

!Finisher
`Deal ~1D12 Damagel` whenever you rolled 10 Dice in one turn.
Can only trigger once per turn.

!Nature's Fortress
`Gain a guaranteed ~20 Shield`.

!Mage
`Recover $1 Mana` at the start of each turn.

!Leeching Burst
`Roll ~4D8 Heal` when you rolled a total of 10 Dice this turn.

!Binding Life
`Receive ~1D12 Heal` at the start of each turn.
